_about: The `actual` of every length_out_of_range report kicad-cli printed for these boards, per release (`pcb drc --severity-all --format json`, one catch-all rule `(condition "A.NetName == '*'") (constraint length (max 0.001mm))` in a sibling .kicad_dru; 10.0.0 on macOS, the others in the kicad/kicad Docker images), 2026-10-25, #1432. A net the release did not report is absent. length_cases has one net per case the measure gates on a release; its arc nets are measured on the parser's chords, within a few um of KiCad's arc length.
